description: Replay of the Bangkok van case (Nov 2024): a 3 km range blaster on Sukhumvit Rd. Route and speed are assumed.

reported: A van carried the device around Bangkok; secondary reports place it in the Sukhumvit area
About 100,000 texts an hour, almost 1 million over three days
Texts impersonated the mobile operator AIS and said reward points were about to expire
The operator AIS helped police locate the device
assumed: The exact streets: Sukhumvit Rd from Nana to Ekkamai
A 10-minute slice of the three days
How many phones run the app: the demo's density of about 19 per km2
That each phone was forced to 2G; the reports do not say

blasters.lure_text: AIS: your reward points expire soon. Redeem your gift now at https://ais-points-demo.example
